title: Path Traversal in os.path.join and Archive Extraction
platform_conditions: CPython 3.x standard library; archive filters require Python 3.12+ (tarfile data filter)
security_mechanism: os.path.join discards the base directory entirely when the second argument is absolute ('/etc/passwd' yields '/etc/passwd'), and keeps '..' segments otherwise, so one join call does not confine the result to the base. Archive members replicate the same flaw at extraction time: tar/zip entry names with absolute paths or '..' escape the extraction root because extractall trusts member names by default. tempfile.mktemp returns a predictable name that another process can create first (symlink race).

source_sink_clues.source: Upload filenames, archive entry names, download/path parameters, or any path component taken from a request.
source_sink_clues.sink: os.path.join(base, attacker_path) whose result reaches open/read/write; tarfile/zipfile extractall on untrusted archives; tempfile.mktemp

tracking_guards: Check for basename() stripping or normalization before join (os.path.basename or PurePath.name), and for a realpath containment check: os.path.realpath(candidate) must startswith realpath(base) + os.sep. For archives, require member-name validation or extraction with the tarfile 'data' filter; for temp files require tempfile.mkstemp or TemporaryFile.
not_candidate_when: The path component is generated server-side (UUID/timestamp), basename is extracted and a realpath containment check rejects escapes, archive extraction uses the data filter or an equivalent member whitelist, or the temporary name comes from mkstemp/NamedTemporaryFile.
public_references: CWE-22: Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory — https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/22.html
CWE-59: Improper Link Resolution Before File Access — https://cwe.mitre.org/data/definitions/59.html
